mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS refNo, o.order_name AS summary, o.creator_id AS applicantId, o.total_amount AS amount, o.create_time AS createTime, o.status FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{orgId} AND o.status = #{status} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS refNo, c.reason AS summary, c.create_user AS applicantId, c.create_time AS createTime, c.status FROM ad_order_change c LEFT JOIN ad_order o ON o.id = c.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE c.organization_id = #{orgId} AND c.status = #{status} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.contract_id AS contractId, ct.contract_no AS refNo, s.apply_remark AS summary, s.applicant_id AS applicantId, s.create_time AS createTime, s.status FROM ad_seal_record s LEFT JOIN ad_contract ct ON ct.id = s.contract_id AND ct.deleted = 0 WHERE s.organization_id = #{orgId} AND s.status = #{status} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.create_time DESC

SELECT ct.id, ct.contract_no AS refNo, ct.contract_name AS summary, ct.create_user AS applicantId, ct.amount AS amount, ct.create_time AS createTime, ct.seal_status AS status FROM ad_contract ct WHERE ct.organization_id = #{orgId} AND ct.seal_status = #{sealStatus} AND ct.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ct.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.receipt_no AS refNo, r.remark AS summary, r.create_user AS applicantId, r.amount AS amount, r.create_time AS createTime, r.status FROM ad_receipt r WHERE r.organization_id = #{orgId} AND r.status = #{status} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.payment_no AS refNo, p.remark AS summary, p.create_user AS applicantId, p.amount AS amount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.status FROM ad_payment p WHERE p.organization_id = #{orgId} AND p.status = #{status} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
